optimized_sql:
WITH store_buyers AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2002
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
),
web_buyers AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2002
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
),
catalog_buyers AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2002
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
),
state_addresses AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('IL','TX','ME')
)
SELECT
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
    cd_purchase_estimate,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
    cd_credit_rating,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt3
FROM state_addresses AS sa
JOIN customer AS c ON c.c_current_addr_sk = sa.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_buyers AS sb
    WHERE sb.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_buyers AS wb
    WHERE wb.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM catalog_buyers AS cb
    WHERE cb.cs_ship_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
)
GROUP BY
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
